brand.name: SecureVote
brand.disclaimer: Educational election simulation prototype using fictional data. Strictly not for real government elections.

home.hero_subtitle: Experience modern, accessible democratic participation built with cryptographic audit chaining, ballot anonymity protection, and real-time administrative oversight.
home.features_subtitle: Designed with rigorous cybersecurity principles for educational demonstration.
home.feat_audit_desc: Every administrative action, election transition, and ballot issuance is cryptographically linked in an immutable audit chain.
home.feat_ballot_desc: Voter records and cast ballots are stored in decoupled tables with unique transaction guarantees to prevent duplicate voting while avoiding direct database voter-choice linkage.
home.feat_monitoring_desc: Live candidate counts remain strictly confidential under standard election policy (Policy B), showing turnout metrics until official closing.
home.feat_bilingual_desc: Native Tamil (தமிழ்) and English support with locale-aware calendar formatting and accessible typography.
home.step1_desc: Register with a fictional Demo Voter ID and receive a simulated demo OTP code.
home.step2_desc: Election administrators verify and approve your simulated voter credentials.
home.step3_desc: Review candidate manifestos, make your choice, and confirm with database transaction locks.
home.step4_desc: Verify cryptographic hash chain integrity and view published election certificates.

voter.available_elections_desc: Review candidate lists, check your eligibility, and submit your verified ballot.
voter.participated_desc: Your past voting records. For privacy, candidate selections are never displayed.
voter.rule_1: You may only vote once per election. Duplicate voting is permanently blocked by database constraints.
voter.rule_2: Your vote is recorded anonymously; your candidate choice is decoupled from your voter identity.
voter.rule_3: Review candidate manifestos thoroughly before final confirmation. Votes cannot be modified or recalled.

ballot.title: Official Simulation Ballot
ballot.subtitle: Cast your secret ballot. Please select one candidate below.
ballot.instructions: Click on a candidate card to select. Then click 'Review Selection' to confirm your choice before submission.
ballot.review_warning: Important: Once submitted, your vote is irreversibly recorded in a secure database transaction. Duplicate voting is mathematically prohibited.
ballot.vote_success_msg: Your vote has been verified and permanently committed to the election ballot registry.
ballot.receipt_notice: This reference confirms your participation while keeping your candidate choice mathematically anonymous. Keep for your records.
ballot.error_duplicate: You have already cast a ballot in this election. Duplicate votes are strictly prohibited.
ballot.error_closed: This election is currently closed. Ballot submissions are not accepted.
ballot.error_not_eligible: You are not eligible to vote in this election.

election_info.no_candidates_desc: Candidates will appear here once registered by election administrators.

results.title: Certified Election Results
results.subtitle: Official tally and statistical breakdown for concluded simulation elections.
results.not_published_msg: The election administrator has not yet authorized the publication of results for this election. Candidate-wise totals remain confidential.
results.disclaimer: Simulated election outcome. Educational prototype tally reconciliation.

admin.dashboard_subtitle: System health, live oversight, voter management, and audit integrity controls.

monitoring.title: Live Election Monitoring
monitoring.policy_a: Policy A: Live candidate counts displayed (Simulation Mode)
monitoring.policy_b: Policy B: Turnout only during voting (Default Fair Election Standard)
monitoring.policy_b_notice: Under Policy B, candidate-wise counts remain confidential during voting to prevent voter influence. They will be revealed once the election closes and results are certified.

audit.title: Tamper-Evident Audit Chain
audit.subtitle: Cryptographically linked record of every system event, election transition, and ballot issuance.
audit.verification_success: Audit Chain Verification PASSED! All records verified with mathematical integrity.
audit.verification_failed: CRITICAL INTEGRITY BREACH: Hash mismatch detected at block ID
audit.disclaimer: Hash chaining makes unauthorized modifications immediately detectable. Under educational prototype design, database administrator root access could theoretically rewrite both chain and hashes.

security.title: Security Events & Threat Monitoring
security.subtitle: Real-time surveillance of authentication anomalies, rate-limiting violations, and tampering attempts.

analytics.title: Election Analytics & Integrity Reports
analytics.subtitle: Aggregated turnout statistics, voter participation breakdown, and data reconciliation.
analytics.reconciliation_desc: Cross-verifying voter participation records against total anonymous ballots stored.
